basic_details.job_title: ICAR CIRCOT Young Professional Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 20 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Central Institute for Research on Cotton Technology (ICAR CIRCOT) has announced 20 vacancies for Young Professional – I (YP-I) Under “State-wise Ginning Outturn (GOT) study” posts at Nagpur, Guntur, Coimbatore, Dharwad, Sirsa, Surat, and Mumbai locations on a contract basis. The engagement tenure runs from 1 November 2026 to 31 March 2027 and up to 30 September 2027, with a consolidated pay of Rs. 30,000 per month. Eligible candidates holding the prescribed Bachelor’s degree or Three-Year Diploma must fill the application form in PDF format and send it through email on or before 30 October 202

age_limit.details: Minimum age will be 21 years and maximum age will be 45 years. qualification.details: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Commerce, or Information Technology, OR a Three-Year Diploma in Engineering and Technology. For Commerce and Information Technology categories, graduation with a minimum of 60% marks is required. For the Commerce category, a minimum of 1 year of experience in the relevant field is also required.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Commerce, or Information Technology, OR a Three-Year Diploma in Engineering and Technology. For Commerce and Information Technology categories, graduation with a minimum of 60% marks is required. For the Commerce category, a minimum of 1 year of experience in the relevant field is also required. Minimum age will be 21 years and maximum age will be 45 years. Relaxation is applicable as per government rules: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 10 years for PH candidates. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated amount of Rs. 30,000/- per month. TA/DA will be admissible for undertaking domestic tours for official work as per ICAR Rules. Income tax or any other tax liable under prevailing rules will be deducted at source before effecting the payment of monthly salary.

content_sections.heading: ICAR CIRCOT Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Young Professionals will work under the project titled “State-wise Ginning Outturn (GOT) study”. They may be posted at any regional units and their working hours will be the same as regular employees of ICAR.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR CIRCOT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill out the application form in PDF format as per the attached format in the official notification. Affix a recent passport-size photograph on the detailed bio-data. Gather self-attested photocopies of certificates in support of age, qualifications, experience, testimonials, and other credentials. Send the filled application along with all relevant documents through email to [email protected] on or before 30 October 2026, 05:30 am. For hybrid mode interviews, the link will be shared through your communicated email ID. Attend the interview along with a typed application addressed to the Director, ICAR-CIRCOT, Mumbai, along with original certificates and testimonials.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process involves a hybrid mode interview. Interviews are scheduled on 03.11.2026 at GTC, Nagpur for Nagpur post; on 04.11.2026 at Mumbai for Guntur, Coimbatore, Dharwad, Sirsa, and Surat posts; and on 05.11.2026 at Mumbai for Mumbai posts. No T.A. / D.A. will be paid for appearing in the interview.

Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification of candidature.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for ICAR CIRCOT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 20 vacancies for the Young Professional-I (YP-I) position under the State-wise Ginning Outturn (GOT) study.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for ICAR CIRCOT YP-I posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 30 October 2026 by 05:30 am.

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly salary for ICAR CIRCOT Young Professional-I?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly pay of Rs. 30,000/-.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential qualifications required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Commerce, or Information Technology, or a Three-Year Diploma in Engineering and Technology, with specific percentage and experience requirements for Commerce and IT categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ICAR CIRCOT YP-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 45 years, with age relaxations applicable for SC, ST, OBC, and PH candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. How should I submit my application?
faq.answer: Applications must be filled in PDF format as per the attached application form and sent via email to [email protected] along with relevant documents.

faq.question: Q7. When and where will the interviews be conducted?
faq.answer: Interviews will be held in hybrid mode from 3 November 2026 to 5 November 2026 at Nagpur and Mumbai venues depending on the post location.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, these posts are purely temporary and contractual in nature up to the completion of the project.
